extracted_data.name: Tejas C. Waghmare
extracted_data.summary: Passionate Data Analyst dedicated to uncovering patterns, telling compelling data stories, and driving business growth through analytics. With expertise in Power BI, SQL, Python, and Excel, Ihelp organizations make data-driven decisions that matter. Experienced in building interactive dashboards, KPI tracking systems, and business intelligence solutions across real-world internships and projects.

experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
bullets: Built interactive Power BI dashboards through a 4-week program, transforming raw data into actionable business insights for decision-making.
Completed a 20-hour curriculum covering data modeling, DAX, visualization best practices, and real-world BI use cases.

experience.title: Project Engineer
bullets: Automated Excel dashboards (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP) and developed real-time Power BI dashboards for KPI tracking and executive reporting.
Improved data accuracy through cleaning, validation, and preprocessing via Excel and ERP systems; identified trends and performance gaps.

experience.title: Graduate Trainee Engineer — Emerging Technologies (Score: 87%)
experience.company: Bajaj BEST×ASDC (Automotive Skills Development Council) India
bullets: Gained hands-on experience in Data Analysis and Data Visualization using Power BI, Excel, and SQL to analyze datasets, build visual reports, and derive actionable insights.
Acquired introductory knowledge of AI & Machine Learning concepts including supervised learning, predictive modeling, and their real-world applications in data analytics.

projects.title: NYC Airbnb Data Analysis & Business Intelligence
projects.tools: SQL, Power BI, DAX, Power Query
bullets: Analyzed 30,259 NYC Airbnb listings across 16,441 hosts, uncovering pricing, occupancy, revenue, review, host, room-type, and location insights.
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard using SQL, DAX, and data modeling to analyze$389.3M estimated revenue, 52.4% average occupancy, and 980K+ total reviews.
Identified key marketplace patterns across 5 NYC boroughs, 4 room types, Superhost status, and host portfolios.

projects.title: Bakery Sales, Profitability & Waste Analysis
projects.tools: Excel, Power Pivot, PivotTables, Data Modeling
bullets: Analyzed 16,569 bakery transactions (2023–2024) across 3 stores using a star-schema data model and interactive Excel dashboards to track revenue, profit, discount, and waste KPIs.
Uncovered that waste cost equaled 40% of revenue and deep discounts drove a−6.7% margin; recommended capping discounts at about 5% and cutting waste 20–25% to return the business to profit.

projects.title: Amazon Sales Dashboard
projects.tools: Power BI, DAX, Data Modeling, Geo Mapping
bullets: Built a 3-page interactive dashboard analyzing 50K+ orders and$32.8M revenue across 6 product categories and 5 global regions.
Identified Beauty as the top revenue driver and revealed uniform discount distribution across all categories.
